payload.reason: The evidence provides information on how lexicons are compared through crowd evaluations and expert assessments, highlighting the differences in methods and outcomes.

claims.text: Crowd evaluations of lexicons are compared to those of expert linguists to assess quality.
Lexicon acquisition involves both subjective and objective tasks, with different evaluation methods for each.
The proposed crowdsourcing method for lexicon acquisition is scalable and cost-effective, allowing for comparison with expert evaluations.
